sources.organization: State Bank of Pakistan, Islamic Finance Policy Department
sources.document_title: Shariah Governance Framework for Islamic Banking Institutions (Effective from: January 01, 2025)
sources.standard_number: SGF 2025 (issued under IFPD Circular No. 08 of 2024)
sources.clause: All products or services to be offered and/or launched by the IBI shall have prior approval of the SB; SB shall review and approve procedure manuals, product programs/structures, process flows, related agreements
sources.page: printed pages 1 and 5 of the SGF booklet (PICG-hosted PDF)
sources.authority_level: Tier 1 text via public republication of the official SGF
sources.scope: IBIs in Pakistan. Not LendingClub. Not SECP-only NBFCs.
sources.notes: Official sbp.org.pk annex PDF was not retrievable here (403). Machine mapping uses the PICG-hosted PDF whose title page identifies Islamic Finance Policy Department, State Bank of Pakistan, effective 1 January 2025, matching IFPD Circular 08 of 2024. SHA-256 of the downloaded PDF is recorded. This is not an AAOIFI product-structure standard.
